mmlupro.description: MMLU-Pro on one 100-question subset, one model.
mmlupro.label: mmlupro-{model}-{subset}

jetson._memory_mb: E4B on the Jetson peaks at +5,008 MB (worst of 4 runs, baseline and thinking). 5,400 left ~400 MB spare and refused real idle boards at 5,257, costing 10.7 h on 2026-09-24; thinking runs started at 5,238-5,239 have bottomed at 354-441 MB free. 5,200 keeps ~190 MB over the worst peak; raise it again if a run ever comes closer.

mmlupro-lg.description: S3: MMLU-Pro through little-gemma (CUDA int8), one 100-question subset, one model. Jetson only: little-gemma's fast path is CUDA.
mmlupro-lg.label: mmlupro-lg-{model}-{subset}
mmlupro-lg._memory_mb: Pilots 2026-09-25 (14 questions each): E2B peaked at +2,340 MB over idle, E4B thinking-on at +3,990 MB (5,898 MB used of 7,485). The engine does not mmap and refuses to load when the tensor data exceeds available memory, so E4B needs ~4.2 GB free regardless. Tighten after the first full runs.

mmlupro-ae.description: S9, the proposed engine: little-gemma + ae.patch, MMLU-Pro on one 100-question subset, one model, thinking off. variant picks the switches (std_mmlupro_lg_jetson.sh): base = none, reuse = shared-prefix KV, ngram = prompt-lookup drafts, full = both. No MTP head: neither baseline ran speculative decoding. All greedy-exact: ae_gate.py must find replies byte-identical to S3 before a full run counts.
mmlupro-ae.label: mmlupro-ae-{variant}-{model}-{subset}
mmlupro-ae._memory_mb: As mmlupro-lg until measured: -reuse adds one prefix snapshot (39 MiB on E2B, logged as 'kv prefix snapshot').

mmlupro-ngram.description: S10: llama.cpp with its own n-gram speculative decoding (--spec-type ngram-simple), the fair baseline for S9. cfg default = llama.cpp's own knobs; n3mK = 3-token lookup, K-token drafts (verify width K+1), as S9. MMLU-Pro, one subset, one model, thinking off.
mmlupro-ngram.label: mmlupro-ngram-{cfg}-{model}-{subset}

mmlupro-tq.description: S8: MMLU-Pro with a TurboQuant turbo3 KV cache (pinned llama.cpp fork), one 100-question subset, one model. Both boards.
mmlupro-tq.label: mmlupro-tq-{model}-{subset}
mmlupro-tq._memory_mb: The mmlupro numbers: turbo3 only shrinks the KV cache, a few hundred MB at -c 8192, so the f16 peaks bound it. Tighten after the first runs.

mmlupro-letter.description: S4: MMLU-Pro with the answer constrained to a letter, no chain of thought (std_mmlupro_letter.sh, the mmlu_pro_letter task). rotate shifts every question's options by N places, gold included: the permutation-ensemble runs analyze_permutation.py reads; 0 is the plain task. Same server flags as the baseline. Pi only: the script drives va-llm.
mmlupro-letter.label: mmlupro-letter-{model}-{subset}
mmlupro-letter._memory_mb: The mmlupro numbers: same server, and at most 16 generated tokens per question, so its peak is below the chain-of-thought baseline's.

ae-gate.description: S9 quality gate (ae_gate.py): replay questions the S3 run already answered (mmlupro100-lg-<model>-<subset>) through the proposed engine with these switches; every reply must come back byte-identical. A short sweep of per_category questions per subject, not a benchmark run. Jetson only.
ae-gate.label: ae-sweep-{model}-{name}
ae-gate._memory_mb: As mmlupro-lg: the same engine and model files.

raw.description: Any command, wrapped in run_measured.sh. The escape hatch.
raw.label: {label}
